title: cogswellia lucida
intro: Cogswellia lucida, commonly known as the Kashmir Cedar or Atlas Cedar, is a species of flowering plant in the cypress family (Cupressaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cogswellia lucida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including terpenes and essential oils, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been traditionally used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and skin conditions.
